verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only installation paths: the Claude Code plugin marketplace commands, copying the skill folder into a skills directory, or uploading a zip. Nothing in the evidence describes listing installed components, uninstalling, or confirming a clean removal with no orphaned files. Any listing or removal through the plugin system would be a host-platform feature, and deleting a copied folder by hand is a user-side workaround; neither earns credit for this story.
